_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Putting your parts in a ply cart…

description: Put every part from price_cart into one ply cart and get the link to finish the order on plyparts.com (shipping, payment, engineer review). Pass the same parts list. Nothing is charged here.

parts.description: Every part in the cart (up to 40): a built part (template + sizes) or a file (path from price_file), each with its own material, color, strength and quantity

armA.description: tslot-plate: holes along the first arm

armB.description: tslot-plate: holes along the second arm

board.description: plate/tslot-mount: a circuit board whose mounting holes ply places from the maker's drawing (rpi5 = Raspberry Pi 5, rpi4b = Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, rpi3bplus = Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+, rpizero2w = Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W / Zero W, pico = Raspberry Pi Pico, rpicam = Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 / v2, uno = Arduino Uno (R3 / R4), mega = Arduino Mega 2560, jetson-orin-nano = NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit, esp32-devkitc = Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4, esp32-s3-devkitc = Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (v1.1), xiao-esp32s3 = Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3, heltec-v4 = Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4, heltec-v3 = Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3, esp32-cam = AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM, ipi-smarc-rb5 = ADLINK I-Pi SMARC RB5 (I-Pi SMARC Plus carrier), esp32-devkit-v1-30 = ESP32 DevKit V1, 30 pins (generic), esp32-38-wide = ESP32 38-pin board, wide with 4 holes (generic), esp32-38-narrow = ESP32 38-pin board, narrow (fits most copies)); also give width/depth (hole pattern + 12 mm), screw and, on tslot-mount, standoffHeight

centerHole.description: tslot-cap: hole to reach the end bolt

color.description: Color name, e.g. black, white, red (default black)

compartmentsY.description: tray: compartments front to back (1 = none)

cornerRadius.description: plate: outside corner radius, 0 = square; box: inside corner radius (mm)

drain.description: tray: drain holes through each compartment's floor

dripTray.description: tray: a drip tray it sits in (use with drain holes)

extraHoles.description: plate: holes at exact spots, x/y = hole center in mm from the plate's center

holeDiameter.description: plate: diameter of the pattern holes; bracket: hole diameter (0 = no holes) (mm)

holeInset.description: plate, corner holes: distance from each edge to the hole center (mm)

holeStyle.description: with screw: plain hole, screw threads into the plastic, counterbored, countersunk (flat head), hex nut pocket, or heat-set insert

holesA.description: bracket: holes in the base leg

holesB.description: bracket: holes in the upright leg

keys.description: tslot-bracket/mount/panel: alignment keys that sit in the slot

material.description: Material name or id, e.g. PLA, PETG, ASA, TPU (default PLA).

outerDiameter.description: spacer/washer: outside diameter (hex: across the flats) (mm)

pattern.description: tray: design pressed into the outside walls

plugDepth.description: tslot-cap: plug length into the slots (mm)

process.description: fdm = plastic (default); resin = fine detail (miniatures, figurines, smooth looks)

profile.description: T-slot parts: the extrusion (8020-10 = 80/20 10 series 1 in, 8020-15 = 15 series 1.5 in, m20 = 20 mm / 2020)

screw.description: plate/bracket/tslot-mount: the screw the holes are for (ply sizes them; omit or custom = use holeDiameter)

shape.description: spacer/washer: round or hex; tslot-plate: L, T, X, straight or gusset

slotOffset.description: tslot-mount: slot line from the plate's center, across (mm)

span.description: tslot-bracket: one or two profiles wide

strength.description: Plastic parts only. Default balanced; strong for parts under load

template.description: plate = flat plate with holes; bracket = L-bracket; spacer = spacer/standoff; washer; box = box with optional lift-off lid, sized by the inside; tray = open tray / bin / organizer sized by the OUTSIDE (width, depth, height), optional compartments; for T-slot aluminum extrusion (pick its profile): tslot-bracket = corner bracket, tslot-plate = joining plate, tslot-mount = mounting plate (bolts into a slot + the customer's own holes), tslot-cap = end cap / foot, tslot-cover = slot cover, tslot-panel = panel clip, tslot-cable = cable clip

units.description: Units of an STL/OBJ file, which doesn't say (default mm). Use in if the part comes out 25x too small.

thumbs.description: Leave empty (the ply card fills in pictures).

name: order_cart
title: Order several parts on ply
